name: Jefferson Shreve
bio: a Representative from Indiana; born in Indiana, September 1965; graduated from Silver Creek High School, Sellersburg, Ind., 1984; B.A., Indiana University, Bloomington, Ind., 1989; M.A., University of London, London, England, 1998; M.B.A., Purdue University, West Lafayette, Ind., 2003; business owner; member of the Indianapolis, Ind., city-county council, 2013-2016, 2018-2019; delegate, Republican National Convention, 2016; elected as a Republican to the One Hundred Nineteenth Congress (January 3, 2025-present).
